title: Privacy Policy
intro: You are on the website hivepal.app, operated by HRVN s.r.o.
operator: We care about the protection of your personal data and your security. We consider the protection of your privacy when processing personal data in all our business processes. Personal data obtained during visits to our website is processed in accordance with applicable data protection regulations, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). The website operator is registered with the Data Protection Authority.

rightToInformation.title: Right to Information
rightToInformation.content: Upon request, we will inform you as soon as possible and in writing whether and what personal data we have recorded about you. If, despite our efforts to ensure the accuracy and timeliness of the data, incorrect or outdated information is recorded, please do not hesitate to contact us, and we will correct it upon request. If you have questions regarding the processing of your personal data, contact us at info@hivepal.app, where we are also available for suggestions or complaints.

security.title: Security
security.content: HRVN s.r.o. implements technical and organizational security measures to protect recorded personal data against manipulation, loss, destruction and unauthorized access, and continuously updates these measures.

dataProtection.title: Data Protection Code
dataProtection.content: When you visit our website, we record the website you came from, the pages you visit, and the date, time and duration of the visit. This information is collected with Umami, a privacy-friendly analytics tool that we host ourselves and that does not use cookies or track you across websites. We also use Sentry to diagnose JavaScript errors and Grafana Faro to measure page performance; these tools may record technical information such as your browser type, device, the page where an error occurred and your IP address. We do not use analytics to identify you or build a profile. Personal data is only recorded when you provide it voluntarily, through the contact form or registration, for a specific purpose.

dataUsage.title: Use and Disclosure of Personal Data
dataUsage.content: HRVN s.r.o. uses your personal data for the purposes of technical administration of the website, administration and communication with you based on questions sent through the form.
dataUsage.marketing: Personal data is used for specific marketing purposes only with explicit consent to process personal data for a specific marketing purpose at the chosen frequency (for example, sending a newsletter once a month, sending information about news and updates).
dataUsage.authorities: Disclosure of personal data to public authorities occurs only within binding legal regulations.

newsletter.title: Newsletter and Marketing Communications
newsletter.content: If you have subscribed to our newsletter, we use your email to send regular information about news, product updates and beekeeping tips. This communication is based solely on your explicit consent.
newsletter.unsubscribe: For communications for specific marketing purposes, you can unsubscribe from emails at any time using the unsubscribe link provided in the footer of each such email, or in your account settings.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We use strictly necessary cookies for signing in, keeping your session secure and remembering your preferences. Our analytics tool Umami does not use cookies and does not identify you across websites. Sentry (error diagnostics) and Grafana Faro (performance measurement) may use your browser's storage to group errors and measurements; this data is not used for advertising. You can clear or block cookies in your browser, but signing in requires the essential cookies.

consent.title: Consent to Personal Data Processing
consent.content: HRVN s.r.o. commits to fully respect the confidential nature of your personal and business data, which is secured against unauthorized access and protected against misuse. Data obtained through the registration form is used exclusively to provide our services and communicate with you. Your personal and contact data is not provided to third parties without your consent.

deletion.title: Deleting Your Data
deletion.content: You can delete your account and all your data at any time, either in the app or by sending us a request.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For any questions regarding the protection of personal data, please contact us at:

dataDeletion.title: Data Deletion
dataDeletion.intro: You can delete your Hive Pal account and all data associated with it at any time. This includes the data we received when you signed in with Facebook or Google: your name, email address and account identifier.

inApp.title: Delete your account in the app
inApp.content: Sign in, open Settings and choose “{{action}}”. Your account and all data you own (apiaries, hives, inspections, photos and linked sign-in accounts) are deleted immediately and cannot be restored.

byEmail.title: Request deletion by email
byEmail.content: If you can no longer sign in, send a deletion request to
byEmail.details: Send it from the email address of your Hive Pal account, or tell us which address the account uses. We delete the account and all associated data within 30 days and confirm by email.

facebook.title: Removing Hive Pal from Facebook
facebook.content: On Facebook you can also remove Hive Pal under Settings & privacy → Settings → Apps and websites. This stops Facebook from sharing data with Hive Pal, but does not delete your Hive Pal account. Use one of the options above for that.

meta.title: Data Deletion - Hive Pal
meta.description: How to delete your Hive Pal account and the data associated with it, including data from Facebook or Google sign-in.

meta.title: Privacy Policy - Hive Pal
meta.description: Read the Hive Pal privacy policy to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
